c49985627.notes: Rusty yellow trail sign on a pole beside Pipeline Road (Camino del Oleoducto), Soberanía National Park (camera 9.1599, -79.7243); small in the frame and weathered. No accent is visible on RIO or SOBERANIA on the sign. The first letter of the fourth line (presumably C of CAMINO) is covered by a white blotch, so it is transcribed as 'AMINO DEL OLEODUCTO'; the final A of SOBERANIA is partly cut by the sign edge. 'INRENARE' is the former natural-resources agency.

lines.text: MERCADO MUNICIPAL DE BOCAS DEL TORO-ISLA COLON

expect.query: Mercado Municipal de Bocas del Toro

c57018810.notes: Red capital letters painted along the balcony fascia of the municipal market building, Bocas del Toro town, Isla Colón (camera 9.3418, -82.2404); frontal. No accent on COLON. Many distractor shop signs on the same facade: 'BOCAS PARTY SHOP', 'ROPA AMERICANA MICHAEL', 'MINI HELADERIA Y DULCERIA ANITA', 'Universal Com' (x3), 'BLOWER', 'RESTAURANTE TOM', 'CARIBBEAN SEAFOOD', 'REFRESQUERIA EBEN EZER', and a 'PROHIBIDO ESTACIONAR BICICLETA DENTRO DEL MERCADO' notice.

c126821130.notes: Large multicoloured 3D letter sign 'PANAMÁ' (acute accent on the final A drawn as a separate block) on the waterfront by a marina in Panama City, skyline behind (no camera location; Commons category 3D letter place name signs in Panama). Small black text on the base, '#VISIT Panama' with social-media icons, is a secondary read.

c17644792.notes: Hand-painted script lettering on a turquoise fascia of a greengrocer in Bocas del Toro province (no camera location). 'Legumbrería' in red, the i carries a slanted stroke read as an acute accent (í); 'José' in blue with a clear acute accent. Large painted fruit mural at left, no other text.

c99004038.notes: Large white 3D block letters on the facade of the football stadium in Colón (no camera location), seen at a steep angle; palm fronds partly cover the D and E of DELY. No accent on VALDES on the sign. A coat-of-arms medallion sits above.

c73441685.notes: Hand-painted wooden plank (upper right) under a tiled shelter in the Darién (no camera location); black marker letters, small hut drawings and a red arrow. Distractor planks: 'Parque Nacional Darién / 3 Kms aprox', 'Pijibasal Community / to 400 mts aprox' (faded green), 'Accommodation Restaurant / Local Guide Handicrafts' and 'Hospedaje - Alimentación / Guías locales y Art...'
